items.title: DataPower堆溢出未认证RCE
items.summary_zh: 未认证远程攻击者可利用边界检查不当触发堆溢出，在DataPower上执行任意代码。
items.action_zh: 立即升级至修复版本；限制网关服务公网暴露
items.repro_note: 未认证向网关服务发送恶意请求触发堆溢出
items.impact_scope: 边界网关设备，常暴露公网
items.description: IBM DataPower Gateway 10.5.0.0 through 10.5.0.22, 10.6.1 through 10.6.6, 10.6.0.0 through 10.6.0.10, and 11.0.0.0 through 11.0.0.2 is vulnerable to a heap-based buffer overflow, caused by improper bounds checking. An unauthenticated remote attacker could overflow the buffer and execute arbitrary code on the system.

items.title: DataPower LDAP空密码认证绕过
items.summary_zh: 远程攻击者利用LDAP认证未拒绝空密码，可能获取DataPower管理权限。
items.action_zh: 升级修复版本；禁用LDAP空密码并限制认证来源
items.repro_note: LDAP认证时提交空密码尝试登录管理接口
items.description: IBM DataPower Gateway 10.5.0.0 through 10.5.0.22, 10.6.1 through 10.6.6, 10.6.0.0 through 10.6.0.10, and 11.0.0.0 through 11.0.0.2 could allow a remote attacker to obtain administrative access due to failure to reject empty passwords during LDAP authentication.

items.title: WOLVOX控制面板敏感信息泄露
items.title_zh: WOLVOX控制面板敏感信息泄露
items.summary_zh: 控制面板用户可拉取系统资源敏感数据，导致配置或凭据泄露，影响ERP业务。
items.action_zh: 升级到26.02.26或更高版本，限制控制面板访问
items.repro_note: 触发控制面板数据拉取功能，检查响应中的系统敏感信息
items.impact_scope: ERP控制面板，内网业务系统
items.description: Insertion of sensitive information into sent data vulnerability in AKIN Software Computer Import-Export Industry and Trade Co. Ltd. AKINSOFT WOLVOX Control Panel allows Pull Data from System Resources. This issue affects AKINSOFT WOLVOX Control Panel: from 26.02.25 before 26.02.26.

items.title: DataPower RFC2047解析越界写
items.summary_zh: 远程攻击者可通过RFC2047编码字解析触发越界写，在DataPower上执行任意代码。
items.action_zh: 升级DataPower至修复版本；限制服务端口暴露
items.repro_note: 构造含恶意RFC2047编码字的请求触发解析器越界写
items.impact_scope: IBM网关设备，可能暴露公网
items.description: IBM DataPower Gateway 10.5.0.0 through 10.5.0.22, 10.6.1 through 10.6.6, 10.6.0.0 through 10.6.0.10, and 11.0.0.0 through 11.0.0.2 could allow a remote attacker to execute arbitrary code due to an out-of-bounds write in the RFC2047 encoded-word parser.

items.title: DataPower本地缓冲区溢出提权
items.summary_zh: 本地用户可利用边界检查不当溢出缓冲区，在DataPower系统上执行任意代码。
items.action_zh: 升级至修复版本；限制本地低权账户访问
items.impact_scope: 本地低权用户，影响网关主机
items.description: IBM DataPower Gateway 10.5.0.0 through 10.5.0.22, 10.6.1 through 10.6.6, 10.6.0.0 through 10.6.0.10, and 11.0.0.0 through 11.0.0.2 is vulnerable to a buffer overflow, caused by improper bounds checking. A local user could overflow the buffer and execute arbitrary code on the system.

items.title: DataPower越界写远程代码执行
items.summary_zh: 远程攻击者可触发越界写，在DataPower网关上执行任意代码，导致系统失陷。
items.action_zh: 升级至修复版本；限制服务端口暴露
items.repro_note: 向受影响服务发送特制请求触发越界写
items.impact_scope: IBM网关设备，可能暴露公网
items.description: IBM DataPower Gateway 10.5.0.0 through 10.5.0.22, 10.6.1 through 10.6.6, 10.6.0.0 through 10.6.0.10, and 11.0.0.0 through 11.0.0.2 could allow a remote attacker to execute arbitrary code due to an out-of-bounds write.

items.title: DataPower缓冲区溢出高危
items.summary_zh: DataPower网关存在缓冲区溢出，可能被利用导致任意代码执行。
items.action_zh: 升级至修复版本；关注厂商安全补丁
items.repro_note: 向受影响组件输入超长数据触发缓冲区溢出
items.description: IBM DataPower Gateway 10.5.0.0 through 10.5.0.22, 10.6.1 through 10.6.6, 10.6.0.0 through 10.6.0.10, and 11.0.0.0 through 11.0.0.2 vulnerable to buffer overflow.

items.title: mJobTime登录面板未授权SQL执行
items.summary_zh: 未授权攻击者可调用Login.aspx回发方法执行任意SQL，以DBA权限操作Sybase数据库。
items.action_zh: 升级至15.7.3.32之后修复版本；限制管理面板访问
items.repro_note: 未授权调用Login.aspx的runQueryButton提交任意SQL
items.impact_scope: 业务管理面板，可控制数据库
items.description: mJobTime through build 15.7.3.32 contains an unauthenticated SQL execution vulnerability in the Login.aspx admin panel handlers, where the runQueryButton postback and exportSqlQuery_Server PageMethod execute caller-supplied SQL against the backing Sybase SQL Anywhere database using DBA/sysadmin privileges with no server-side authentication enforced beyond a client-side sessionStorage flag.
